newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins mobile telephone order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins mobile telephone order.

text.p: German electronics and engineering conglomerate Siemens AG said it had won a 100 million mark contract from E-Plus Mobilfunk GmbH to expand its German mobile telephone network.
E-Plus, Germany's second mobile telephone operator, plans to reach 98 percent of the German population by the end of 1997, up from 80 percent now.
Major shareholders in E-Plus are Thyssen AG, Veba AG and BellSouth of the U.S.
Siemens is to deliver base stations for the first German DCS mobile phone network. DCS networks conform to the architecture of GSM networks, but operate in a different frequency range, Siemens said.
